sections.indications_and_usage: Uses relieves • heartburn • acid indigestion • sour stomach • upset stomach associated with these symptoms
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions • adults and children 12 years of age and over: chew 2-4 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor • do not take for symptoms that persist for more than 2 weeks unless advised by a doctor
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. When using this product • do not take more than 10 tablets in 24 hours • if pregnant do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours • do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks except under the advice and supervision of a doctor Keep out of reach of children.
